selected.look_here_first: Inspect round to shallowly lobed, scalloped leaves and the small pale flowers clustered at leaf axils; confirm the segmented disk-shaped fruit.
Inspect three-toothed leaflets and an elongate raceme of tiny white pea flowers; look for small pods developing along the raceme.
Inspect the trifoliolate toothed leaves, tiny yellow flowers along slender racemes, and miniature legume pods.
Inspect narrow silvery-scaled leaves, silvery twigs, small yellowish fragrant tubular flowers, and olive-like fruits.
Inspect compound or partially bipinnate leaves, large yellow flower panicles and inflated three-sided papery fruit capsules.
Inspect very large opposite heart-shaped leaves, pale lavender tubular flowers and brown woody egg-shaped seed capsules.
Inspect opposite, strongly toothed aromatic leaves on a square stem, and the small two-lipped flowers arranged in slender spikes.
Inspect hairy stalks and lobed leaves, four thin petals, and the characteristic round capsule with a flat radiating stigmatic disk.
Inspect a yellow composite flower head surrounded by narrow phyllaries ending in sharp spines; look for winged stem portions.
